task: ham / phishing-smishing-fraud / unsolicited spam; legacy positive class name smishing is retained for schema compatibility. No sender/authorship claim.
evaluation_scope: Limited source-labelled collections, not modern inbox or universal safety

pretrained_source.initialization: Existing SST2 checkpoint; new three-class head; all layers fine-tuned locally

training_sources.retrieved_via: PhishNet author research repository original unmodified Dataset1; Mendeley download challenged; archive checksum unavailable

training_sources.source: IMC25 reportsmishing; English source-labelled fraud; collection-specific URL placeholders

training_sources.limitations: Hand-classified personal-inbox corpus, possible label errors; raw mail not distributed

training_sources.license: Original senders retain copyright; publicly provided for spam-filter development/research, no blanket CC grant
training_sources.labels: easy_ham remains ham; spam_2 remains spam, never automatically fraud
training_sources.distribution: No raw emails included in runtime or model archive

training_sources.corpora: easy_ham_2 and spam_2002 for corrective development; original labels retained
training_sources.license: Original senders retain copyright; public spam-filter development/research corpus, no blanket CC grant

training.reason: V3 domain-adapted model falsely classified OTP confidentiality/receipt and warning content. Lexical-only correction still failed an explicit model-probability gate; refinement is necessary, not a marginal new experiment.
training.sample_method: Seeded stratified real training retention sample only; no validation/calibration/final rows used for fitting.
training.train_layers: Existing DistilBERT layers4-5 and classifier; embeddings/layers0-3 frozen
training.selection: Prefer checkpoints where all separate authored ham challenge probabilities <.5 and non-fraud argmax, fraud challenge argmax recall >=75%; among them highest real validation macro-F1. If no standalone checkpoint passes, preserve best validation checkpoint and evaluate mixtures under the same strict gate; no gate override.

evaluation.selection_policy: On separate authored challenge, ham fraud alerts must be zero and fraud alert recall >=75%; on real validation ham FPR<=1% and spam FPR<=10%. Among eligible models choose maximum real validation macro-F1 then alert recall. This gate is frozen before fitting. Strong correction gate additionally requires every authored benign challenge to have fraud probability <.5 and non-fraud argmax. This gate rejects hiding high benign fraud probabilities below a raised alert threshold; frozen before the weight8 fit.

final_holdout.scope: All labelled examples retained, including abstentions

presentation.definition: Actual enrichment policy: unsupported/insufficient or low out-of-domain probability abstains; confidence below .65 reviews; likely requires positive probability >=max(.5,threshold) and remaining confidence/domain checks. Uncertainty-only reviews are not counted as detected fraud.
